chapter.heading: A Prayer for Restoration
chapter.v:
Remember, O
Lord, what has come upon us;Look, and behold our reproach! [Matt. 1:1; 3:1; Luke 3:22 b Ps. 2:7; Matt. 14:33; Luke 1:35]

Our inheritance
has been turned over to aliens,And our houses to foreigners. [Mal. 3:1 #; Matt. 11:10; Luke]

We have
become orphans and waifs,Our mothers are like widows. [Is. 40:3 #; Matt. 3:3; Luke 3:4; John 1:23]

We pay
for the water we drink,And our wood comes at a price. [Mal. 4:6 #; Matt. 3:1; Luke 3:3]

They pursue
at our heels;We labor and have no rest. [Matt. 3:5]

We have
given our hand to the EgyptiansAnd the Assyrians, to be satisfied with bread. [Matt. 3:4]

Our fathers
sinned and are no more,But we bear their iniquities. [Matt. 3:11; John 1:27; Acts]

Servants rule
over us;There is none to deliver us from their hand. [Is. 44:3; John 20:22; [Acts 2:4; 10:45, 46; 1 Cor.] [Acts 1:5; 11:16]

We get
our bread at the risk of our lives,Because of the sword in the wilderness. [Matt. 3:13-17; Luke 3:21, 22 Matt. 3:13-17; Luke 3:21-23]

Our skin
is hot as an oven,Because of the fever of famine. [Ezek. 1:1; Matt. 3:16; John 1:32]

They ravished
the women in Zion,The maidens in the cities of Judah. [[Ps. 2:7]; Is. 42:1 #; Matt. 3:17; 12:18; Mark 9:7; Luke 3:22]

Princes were
hung up by their hands,And elders were not respected. [Matt. 4:1-11; Luke 4:1-13 5 sent]

Young men
ground at the millstones;Boys staggered under loads of wood. [Matt. 4:10,]

The elders
have ceased gathering at the gate,And the young men from their music. [Matt. 4:23 6 NU] [Matt. 4:12]

The joy
of our heart has ceased;Our dance has turned into mourning. [Dan. 9:25; [Gal. 4:4; Eph. 1:10; 1 Tim. 2:6]; Titus 1:3 t Matt. 3:2; 4:17; [Acts]

The crown
has fallen from our head.Woe to us, for we have sinned! [Matt. 4:18-22; Luke 5:2-11; John]

Because of
Mount Zion which is desolate,With foxes walking about on it.

You, O
Lord, remain forever;Your throne from generation to generation.

Why do
You forget us forever,And forsake us for so long a time?

Turn us
back to You, O Lord, and we will be restored;Renew our days as of old, [Matt. 4:13; Luke 4:31-37 y Ps. 22:22; Matt. 4:23; Luke 4:16; 13:10]

Unless You
have utterly rejected us,And are very angry with us! [Matt. 7:28, 29;]
